caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with a large vertical mirror attached to the upper section. The dresser is colored in varying shades of brown to simulate wood grain, with detailed black linework accentuating the edges and contours. The base of the dresser consists of two wide drawers, each with two ornate, dark-colored handles. Above the drawers are two small compartments on either side, each with a small drawer, a knob, and a flat, light-colored marble surface on top. The mirror occupies most of the upper section and is flanked on either side by carved decorative columns that feature additional small star-shaped dark accents and ornamental supports. The top of the mirror frame has a highly detailed, arched pediment with additional scrollwork, finials, and decorative motifs, all in the same brown wood-like color. The background is plain and light beige, with some light marks and stains visible. There is a small, handwritten signature in the bottom-right corner.
title: Bureau
